name: MINDHUNTER
description: An agent in the FBI's Elite Serial Crime Unit develops profiling techniques as he pursues notorious serial killers and rapists.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: In 1977, frustrated FBI hostage negotiator Holden Ford finds an unlikely ally in veteran agent Bill Tench and begins studying a new class of murderer.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Holden interviews the eerily articulate murderer Ed Kemper, but his research provokes negative feedback at the Bureau.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Dr. Wendy Carr joins Holden and Tench in their first success, when their insights lead to an arrest.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Bill and Holden consult with Dr. Wendy Carr to begin classifying their subjects. They receive surprising news.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Holden and Bill return to a perplexing case in Pennsylvania where a set of clues leading in multiple directions leaves no shortage of suspects.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Wendy considers an offer. Holden and Bill struggle to communicate the meaning of their findings to the judicial system in the baffling Altoona case.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Wendy takes a career risk to relocate and join the team full time. Holden and Bill find it harder to keep the emotional intensity of work at bay.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Bill and Wendy interview candidates for a fourth member of the team. Holden is intrigued by complaints about a school principal's odd habit.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Holden's methods during a disturbing interview with mass murderer Richard Speck create dissension among the team and kick off an internal FBI probe.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: The team cracks under pressure from an in-house review. Holden's bold style elicits a confession but puts his career, relationships and health at risk.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Amid sweeping changes at the BSU, Holden deals with severe repercussions from his close encounter with Ed Kemper.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: To glean insight into the elusive BTK killer, Bill and Holden interview the Son of Sam, who makes a startling admission.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Bill gets drawn into a horrifying crime that hits close to home. Holden receives an intriguing offer while in Atlanta to interview a pair of killers.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Holden develops a controversial profile in the Atlanta slayings. Wendy conducts her first interview and finds being on the front lines suits her well.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Bill's devastating family situation spills over during his interview with Holden's holy-grail subject: Charles Manson. Wendy's new romance heats up.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: The FBI officially sends the BSU to Atlanta to investigate the missing and murdered children. Wendy second-guesses her interview methods.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Hitting a dead end, Holden suggests a bold plan to draw the killer out. Bill's family faces more scrutiny. Wendy chafes as her job begins to shift.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Red tape hinders Holden's plan to narrow his suspect pool. A weary and heartsick Bill tries to connect with his son. Wendy rethinks her relationship.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: The investigation zeroes in on a prime suspect who proves surprisingly adept at manipulating a volatile situation to his advantage.

awards: Nominated for 2 Primetime Emmys. 5 wins & 34 nominations total
